audience: employees and managers who request absence and track time in Timebutler

useCases.title: Check my vacation balance
useCases.text: Read your vacation and sickness balance for the year. Then list your own absence requests and their status.

useCases.title: Request vacation days
useCases.text: List the absence types, then submit an absence request for your user. The request stays pending if the type needs approval.

useCases.title: Start and stop the time clock
useCases.text: Start the time clock, then stop it to save the time entry. Read the clock status at any time.

useCases.title: Add a finished time entry
useCases.text: List the projects and categories. Then submit a finished entry with a start and end time on the same day.

useCases.title: Review today's work and my time entries
useCases.text: Read today's work summary and the time entries of the current month, with their project and status.

useCases.title: See the team's absence requests
useCases.text: Managers and admins can list the team's absence requests and count the pending ones. The server does not approve or reject requests.
